_meta.title: Mined verb membership (NOT the curated inventory)
_meta.source: Moby Part-of-Speech List (Grady Ward, public domain, Project Gutenberg #3203), cross-checked against CMUdict
_meta.description: Words a public-domain dictionary tags as verbs AND a pronunciation dictionary records. A WEAKER claim than base-verbs.json: these license a morphological split (the residue is a real word, so weeds = weed + -s) but do not attest a predicate, and loom grades such a split Composed rather than Attested. Kept apart because merging them into the curated inventory was measured to cost accuracy - see docs/vocabulary-expansion.md.

stability.means: Use it freely — that is what CC BY is for — but do not assume it holds still. Content churns heavily and the SCHEMA may change without notice: fields renamed, nesting altered, entries removed. Pin a commit if you depend on the shape.
stability.contract: None. No deprecation period, no migration note guaranteed.
stability.why: Mined output, regenerated wholesale rather than edited. Both the mining rules and the corpus cross-check are still being tuned, so entries appear and disappear between regenerations.
